{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Compute conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_rates = sales_df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Sort by conversion rate descending
detailed_conversion_rates = conversion_rates.sort_values(ascending=False)

# Get the segment with the highest conversion rate
highest_conversion_segment = detailed_conversion_rates.index[0]

# Display the conversion rates for all segments
detailed_conversion_rates, highest_conversion_segment"}
